title: Apps Running End To End
description: After the heavy monorepo restructure, get all apps running end to end: fix playground catalog path, electron-forge bun.lock discovery, verify each bun run dev:* boots.
summary:
Unblocked apps after restructure:
1. Patched @electron-forge/core-utils to recognize bun.lock so compose-desktop finds hoisted electron.
2. Added puzzle 2d/3d/5d aliases ("puzzle Nd") so package.json scripts resolve.
3. Set plugin-registry nx.includedScripts=[] so generate uses project.json (was infinite nx recursion).
4. Unknown `dev <app>` no longer silently falls through to compose-desktop.
5. Smoke: 32/32 priority playgrounds HTTP-ready; process3d routes to framework-os-dev and serves :6022.
